hypothesis: Limit capital lockup and long holding losses without replacing the original mean-reversion exit. Test six new time-based overlays and three frozen controls; no expanded RR search.
clock: Measured from actual modeled entry OPEN to each subsequent decision bar CLOSE. Exit at the first available close with elapsed time >= timeout, executed at the configured later OPEN. One-bar latency gives 48/96/144 hours; two-bar latency can add four hours. Original natural exit takes priority when both triggers occur at the same decision. No intrabar clock execution.
losing_only: After at least 96 hours, exit on the first closed decision bar whose cost-adjusted per-BTC liquidation value <= its entry cost: round8(close*(1-slip))*(1-fee) <= round8(entry_open*(1+slip))*(1+fee). This is a per-unit price/fee condition, not quantity-rounded account PnL. Winners may remain open beyond 96 hours and later trigger after turning nonpositive. Gaps at execution may change realized outcome.
episode_block: Once a time exit is decided, set the desired target to zero for the current original raw episode, preventing same-episode reentry. A later raw episode is eligible again. Preserve inherited target-lag semantics for other entries; no same-bar reentry after an exit. The causal target overlay models expected entry OPENs; reject any run with minimum-order entry skips or mismatch between expected and actual entry bars.
sizing: Unchanged pinned v3 allocation and optional 40% annualized volatility cap, no rebalancing while held, no leverage or averaging down. No new stop-loss or profit target. Cashflow, fees, lot floors and minimum orders use the pinned v3 engine and independent oracle.
selection: Use unchanged pinned v2 profit/efficiency selection on training 10000 only, with the six new overlays eligible and original baseline as fallback. b_vol40 and confirm_natural_a100 are comparison-only controls. Profit: normal PnL >= baseline, stress PnL >=1.05*positive baseline (positive if base nonpositive), worst DD <=1.10*base; maximize stress PnL. Efficiency: positive stress CAGR, normal CAGR >=0.75*positive baseline, worst DD <=base, score min(normal CAGR,stress CAGR)/max(normal DD,stress DD) >=1.10*positive baseline score. Evaluation profit requires both PnLs >=base and worst DD <=1.10*base. Evaluation efficiency requires >=1.10*base score, >=0.75*base normal PnL and <=0.80*base normal DD. No retuning after results.
validation: 486 ledgers: 216 Bybit main-window, 216 anchored train/test folds, 54 LBank; independent pinned accounting plus independent timeout-condition replay, 36 control parity comparisons, 54 prefix checks. Select each fold using its past; compound independently liquidated fold returns geometrically. Reuse hash-verified frames; no new exchange requests.
classification: Retrospective follow-up after earlier model searches. All history has already been observed; chronological splits are not pristine unseen-data qualification. Nine paths include repeated controls, and runs/windows are not independent market samples.
